name: logos-marquee
title: Logo marquee
description: A “Trusted by” line over a scrolling strip of grayscale logos that take their colour on hover.

standards.purpose: Borrow credibility by showing organizations that actually use the product.
doNotUseWhen: Logos are aspirational, unlicensed, or no longer customers.

rules.check: Every logo belongs to a current customer or an explicitly labeled partner.
Logos stay legible at small size and keep AA contrast against the section background.
